sites.name: OKC2 (Scale Datacenter)
sites.address: 6000 N Shartel Avenue, Oklahoma City, OK 73118
sites.notes: On the ODEQ active air permit review list (permit 2026-0216-C). The September 2026 major source construction application (ODEQ document 6403875) adds 8 natural gas Wartsila engines to 11 already permitted, 19 in all, giving continuous onsite power for GPU computing: sixteen 20V34SG at 9,000 kWe and three 18V34SG at 5,940 kWe. Not in GEM.

sites.name: CBRE OKC SITE
sites.notes: Title V renewal in comment review, 2026-11-03 to 2026-12-18. The draft permit (ODEQ document 6412652) describes the former Xerox site in Canadian County: process steam boilers, emergency fire pump engines and three emergency generator engines. Whether a data center is planned there is not shown.
